mapper.select:
select `druginfo`.*, `saleinfo`.`sale_price` as salePrice, `supplierinfo`.`supplier_name` as drugSupplier, `purchaseinfo`.`supply_price` as supplyPrice, `purchaseinfo`.`drug_date` as drugDate from `druginfo` left join `saleinfo` on `druginfo`.`saleinfo_id` = `saleinfo`.id left join `supplierinfo` on `druginfo`.`supplierinfo_id` = `supplierinfo`.id left join `purchaseinfo` on `druginfo`.`purchaseinfo_id` = `purchaseinfo`.id
and `druginfo`.`drug_code` = #{drugCode}
and `druginfo`.`drug_name` like concat ('%', #{drugName}, '%')
and `supplierinfo`.`supplier_name` like concat ('%', #{drugSupplier}, '%')
